scope: D2 hourly/minute, timestamp, benchmark offset and source-file anomaly only

parameters.B: minute HH-30 through HH+29, crossing boundaries on continuous UTC axis
parameters.offset_removed_metric: subtract each 24h curve mean only for diagnostic shape comparison
parameters.meanField_fit: median constant offset across complete 24h days; not a correction

archive_hourly_interval_definition: UNKNOWN: archive header says 1-hour but does not state averaging window; external INTERMAGNET standard says minutes 00–59

D2-TIME.basis: A is exact truncation-to-0.1nT of 60 valid minute means for every matched X/Y/Z hour; B/C errors are much larger

D2-DATA.XYZ: EQUIVALENT on 60-valid-minute hours; exact truncation and observed 54/60 availability rule
D2-DATA.F: UNRESOLVED: 22,577 matched F hours differ from truncation of minute A by 0.1 nT; cause not established

D2-BENCHMARK.basis: Sq February benchmark is 24h-mean-centered despite documented night baseline; six February Y/Z meanField/mode pairs are byte-identical
